car:
Build me a 3D website with a Range Rover in the center.

As I scroll down, the car should break apart piece by piece, showing all the major parts inside, almost like reverse engineering the entire car.

The further I scroll, the more separated the parts should become.

When I scroll back up, everything should smoothly come back together until the Range Rover is complete again.

Add a button at the bottom that says "Fix the car". Clicking it should immediately reassemble the entire car.

Make it dark, clean, premium and very smooth.
brain:
Build me a 3D website with a human brain in the center.

As I scroll down, the brain should separate into its different major parts so I can clearly see each section.

The further I scroll, the more separated the parts should become.

When I scroll back up, the brain should smoothly come back together.

Add a button that says "Reassemble brain" and make the whole experience clean, smooth and visually impressive.
city:
Build a detailed 3D browser walkthrough of ancient Jerusalem during the Second Temple period.

Create the Temple area, stone streets, gates, courtyards, buildings and the surrounding city.

Use warm stone textures, realistic lighting and a cinematic late afternoon atmosphere.

Let me walk through the environment using WASD or arrow keys and use the mouse to look around.

Also add a guided tour that smoothly takes me through the main parts of the city.

Make it feel like a proper 3D environment, not cubes on a flat plane.
game:
Build a polished, playable 3D browser shooting game set in ancient Jerusalem during the Second Temple period.

Create a detailed city with stone streets, gates, markets and the Temple area, not simple cubes on a flat plane.

Controls:

- WASD or arrow keys to move
- Mouse to look around
- Click to shoot
- R to reload

Use artificial targets around the city, with a score, ammo counter and timer.

Make it work on the first click with no blocking intro screen.
video:
Create a polished AI video using my clone, speaking directly to camera about the GPT-6 Astra release.

Use my existing clone/reference and keep my face, voice and appearance consistent.

Have me say:

"OpenAI just released GPT-6 Astra, and I've been testing it for the last 48 hours. I've used it to build 3D websites, games, AI videos and even a full content system, and I genuinely wasn't expecting it to be this good."

Make it feel like a natural creator video with realistic lip sync, subtle hand gestures, natural facial expressions and slight camera movement.

Keep the background clean and modern. No captions or extra text.
dashboard:
Build a polished AI content dashboard with multiple agents handling different parts of the content workflow.

Include agents for:

- Trend research
- Keyword research
- Content ideas
- Hook writing
- Script writing
- Caption writing

Let me enter a topic, then have each agent generate its part automatically and pass the results to the next one.

Show everything in one clean dashboard with sections for trends, keywords, ideas, hooks, scripts and captions.

Make it feel like a real working content OS, not a static mockup.
content:
Give me 10 short-form content ideas about GPT-6 Astra for creators, founders and people who use AI for work.

Focus on practical use cases, surprising things people can build, and angles that could perform well on Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn. Avoid generic ideas.

Then pick the strongest idea and write a 60 to 90 second short-form video script about 5 impressive things I built with GPT-6 Astra:

- a 3D Range Rover website
- a 3D walkthrough of ancient Jerusalem
- a playable 3D game
- an AI video clone
- a viral content dashboard

Start with a strong hook, keep the language simple and natural, and make it sound like a creator sharing something they actually tested.

Do not make it sound promotional or overly polished.

End with: Comment "AGI" and I'll send you the prompts and links.
useCases:
I want you to help me figure out the highest value things I could build with GPT-6 Astra for my work.

Here is my information:

My profession: [YOUR PROFESSION]

My industry: [YOUR INDUSTRY]

What I currently do day to day: [DESCRIBE YOUR MAIN TASKS]

The people I work with or sell to: [YOUR AUDIENCE OR CUSTOMERS]

The biggest repetitive tasks in my work: [LIST THEM]

The things that currently take me the most time: [LIST THEM]

The tools I already use: [LIST YOUR TOOLS]

My skill level with AI: [BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE / ADVANCED]

What I want AI to help me achieve: [YOUR GOAL]

Based on this, give me 10 high value things I could build with GPT-6 Astra.

Do not give me generic suggestions like "write emails", "generate ideas" or "summarize documents".

Focus on things that actually take advantage of Astra's ability to code, build software, work with files, use computers, research, create interactive experiences and handle multi-step tasks.

For each idea, tell me:

1. What I should build
2. The problem it solves
3. How I would use it in my actual work
4. Why Astra is useful for this
5. How difficult it would be to build, from 1 to 5
6. Whether it could save me time, make me money, or both

Then rank all 10 ideas from highest value to lowest value for my specific profession.

Finally, take the #1 idea and write the exact prompt I can paste into Codex or ChatGPT Work to build the first version.

Keep that build prompt simple enough that I can understand and edit it myself.
